g.text: Height by age, according to the World Health Organization.

text.style: font-size: 7.75px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #777777

g.text: Note: A child is considered stunted if their height is more than 2 standard deviations below the median for children of the same age, shown here by the dashed line, the

text.style: font-size: 7.75px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; fill: #777777

g.text: lower edge of the shaded area. In the reference population, roughly 2.3% of children fall below this cutoff.
